resources.string: Willbolt uses this permission for four things, all on your phone: (1) to see which app or website is open (it reads the app name, window text and the browser address bar) so it can block the ones you chose and count your time in apps; (2) to take a screenshot every few seconds and check it for adult content with a model on the phone - the picture is never saved or sent; (3) only while a lock you made with Willbolt\'s own protection on is locked, to keep itself from being switched off or removed; and (4) to press Home or lock the screen when something is blocked. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
While Willbolt is a device administrator, Android\'s Settings will not let anyone stop, clear or remove it until the administrator is switched off. Willbolt requests no other administrator powers.
